title: Modified HMW DNA Isolation from Stramenopiles with Agar Plugs
author: Vincent A Bielinski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wenfbde
materials: Let cells sit on ice 1 min
Allow tube to cool to RT
Invert tube slowly 10 times until mixed

steps.title: Prepare Agarose Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2% LMP agarose solution in TAE.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 g of LMP agarose to 25 mL TAE.
Microwave for 30 seconds or until the solution begins to bubble; repeat 2-3x as necessary.
Move flask to a 50 °C air incubator and swirl a few times to bring agarose into solution.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellets
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell pellets for protoplasting.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 50 mL conical vial containing cell pellets (~1.5 g) on ice.
Add 50 mL 1M sorbitol and resuspend the pellet gently.
Harvest the pellet by centrifuging for 10 min at 3000 x g at 4 °C.
Remove the sorbitol wash supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 5 mL protoplasting solution.
Incubate the cell suspension at 37 °C for 10 min, then remove from the water bath.

steps.title: Cast Cell-Agar Plugs
steps.instruction: Embed the cell suspension into agarose plugs.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 mL of warm 2% agarose with the cell suspension.
Pipette 100 µL of the cell-agar solution into disposable plug molds (Biorad #170-3713), using wide-bore tips if necessary to prevent clogging.
Place molds at 4 °C for 15-30 min to solidify.
Transfer solidified plugs to a new 50 mL conical vial using the provided comb.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins and lyse cells within the agarose plugs.

substeps.instruction: Wash plugs with 25 mL of wash buffer for 30 min at RT with soft shaking (e.g., on an orbital rocker taped on its side).
Add 10-20 mL of proteinase K solution (enough to cover the plugs).
Incubate for 24 hrs at 50 °C.
Wash plugs 2x with 25 mL of wash buffer (30 min at RT per wash).
Add 10-20 mL of Pronase solution to the plugs (optional).
Incubate plugs in Pronase solution for 4 hrs at 37 °C.
Wash plugs 2x with 25 mL wash buffer (30 min at RT per wash).

steps.title: Agarose Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the agarose matrix to release the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 3-4 plugs (or more) from the conical vial into a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Wash 2x with 500 µL of 1x beta-agarase wash buffer (NEB: 10 mM Bis-Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 6.5@25°C) on ice for 30 min each cycle.
Remove excess wash buffer with a pipette.
Heat the tube at 65 °C for 10 min in a heating block.
Cool the block and solution to 42 °C (allow at least 10 min to cool to avoid agarase inactivation).
Add 1U Beta-agarase per 100 µL of melted agarose volume.
Incubate for 1-2 hr at 42 °C, mixing every 30 min or shaking gently.
Store at 4 °C overnight or proceed immediately to extraction.

steps.title: Phenol Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract HMW DNA using phenol (perform in a fume hood with proper PPE).

substeps.instruction: Mix 250 µL of liquefied agar solution with 250 µL of Tris-buffered phenol.
Rock end-over-end slowly for 10 min at RT (up to 1 hour for higher yield).
Centrifuge for 10 min at 16,100 x g to separate phases.
Transfer the aqueous layer (~250 µL) to a new tube.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation and Washing
steps.instruction: Precipitate and purify the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL of 3M NaOAc to the tube.
Add 825 µL of 100% EtOH.
Incubate at -20 °C for a minimum of 1 hr (or overnight for increased yield).
Centrifuge for 20 min at 16,100 x g at RT using the lowest acceleration/deceleration speed to avoid shearing.
Gently remove the supernatant with a pipette.
Wash the pellet quickly in 500 µL 70% EtOH + 50mM CaCl2.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 16,100 x g at RT.
Repeat the 70% EtOH + 50 mM CaCl2 wash and centrifuge for 5 min at 16,100 x g at RT.
Remove the wash solution with a pipette.
Air dry the pellet for 5-10 min at RT.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension and Analysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA and verify quality.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet in 50-100 µL TE, pH 8.0 (DO NOT MIX WITH PIPETTE). If needed, leave at 4 °C overnight or heat to 37 °C for 10 min to solubilize.
Analyze 5 µL of the resuspended pellet on a 0.8% agarose gel using wide-bore tips to prevent shearing.
Measure concentration using Qubit quantitation.
